annotations.title: Prompt or model A/B test sample size

description: Returns how many results each version of a prompt or model needs before a difference in how often results work first time is statistically real (two-proportion z-test, two-sided), the total across both versions, and how many days that takes at a given daily volume.

baselinePct.description: Share of version A's (the current prompt or model) results that work first time, percent (above 0, below 100)

powerPct.description: Chance of detecting a real difference of this size, percent

resultsPerDay.description: Results per day across both versions, split evenly. Gives the number of days.

targetPct.description: Share of version B's results that work first time, percent (above 0, below 100)

name: ab_test_sample_size

alpha.description: False-positive rate, 1 minus the confidence level

otherLifts.description: The same test for B at +2, +5, +10 and +15 points; null where B would pass 100%

permalink.description: A page on this site that shows this result, for a person to open

title: Prompt or model A/B test sample size
